reason: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. The sachet idea fits my gym bag, but I'm not paying a premium for it when I could get magnesium for a lot less.
objection: It costs more than the stuff I already know, and I'd be paying extra just for the packaging. I don't know yet that this magnesium works any better.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $20 for the 30 days, or a first box at the launch price that is clearly cheaper than Toplux.
